newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Central Bank offers longer-term bills.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Central Bank offers longer-term bills.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Wednesday started offering longer-term special series Treasury bills in a bid to siphon liquidity, traders said.
It is now issuing 92-day bills at an interest rate of 10.875 percent and 182 days at 11.20 percent.
Last Tuesday, it offered 79 and 85-day term bills at 10.875 percent.
"There's too much liquidity in the market. The Central Bank is offering alternative instruments for banks to place their money in," a dealer said.
